title: Prepositions of Direction
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora sabes cómo describir el movimiento y la dirección en inglés usando preposiciones.

parts.visual: Usamos preposiciones de dirección para mostrar hacia dónde va algo o alguien. TO (hacia / a un destino): I am going to the office. FROM (desde un origen): He is coming from London.
parts.audio: We use prepositions of direction to show where someone or something is going. TO means towards a destination: I am going to the office. FROM means the origin: He is coming from London.

parts.visual: INTO (hacia adentro): She walked into the meeting room. OUT OF (hacia afuera): He walked out of the building. TOWARDS (en dirección a, no necesariamente llegando): Walk towards the elevator.
parts.audio: INTO means going inside: She walked into the meeting room. OUT OF means going outside: He walked out of the building. TOWARDS means in the direction of: Walk towards the elevator.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la preposición de dirección correcta.

questions.question: I am traveling ____ Tokyo next week. (A/Hacia).
The CEO just arrived ____ New York. (Desde).
questions.explanation: From indica origen: from New York.

questions.question: Please come ____ my office. (Hacia adentro).
questions.explanation: Into indica entrar: into my office.

questions.question: The manager walked ____ the room angry. (Hacia afuera de).
questions.explanation: Out of indica salir: out of the room.

questions.question: Walk ____ the reception desk and turn left. (En dirección a).
Send the report ____ the client. (A).
questions.explanation: Destino de una acción: to the client.

questions.question: I got an email ____ the supplier. (De/Desde).
Put the documents ____ the folder. (Hacia el interior de).
Take the paper ____ the printer. (Afuera de/Sácalo de).
He is driving ____ the airport now. (Hacia/A).
The train ____ Paris departs at 9 AM. (A/Destino).
Did you take my pen ____ my desk? (Fuera de / Sacar de).
questions.explanation: Out of = sacar algo de un espacio.

questions.question: The visitors are walking ____ the main entrance. (En dirección a).
Please transfer the call ____ the sales department. (A).
He threw the paper ____ the wastebasket. (Hacia adentro de).
Get ____ the car, we are late. (Hacia adentro de).
Get ____ the taxi here. (Hacia afuera de - Bajarse).
Go ____ the end of the corridor. (Hasta / A).
They moved ____ the old office last week. (Hacia afuera / Se mudaron de).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la preposición correcta: to, from, into, out of, towards.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am traveling to Tokyo next week.
options: I am traveling to Tokyo next week.
He is traveling to Tokyo next week.
I will travel to Tokyo next week.
I am moving to Tokyo next week.
questions.correct_answer: I am traveling to Tokyo next week.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The CEO just arrived from New York.
options: The CEO just arrived from New York.
The manager arrived from New York.
The CEO is arriving from New York.
The CEO just arrived to New York.
questions.correct_answer: The CEO just arrived from New York.

The manager stepped out of the room.

questions.question: Listen carefully.

Put the files into the folder.
